about_the_game:
A new love, forever...

"LoveR Kiss Endless Memories" is a youth romance simulation game themed around photography and romance. As a member of the photography club, players will deepen their bonds with seven heroines through their daily school life.

Key Features

♥ Abundant Romance Events

Each heroine has her own unique story and a variety of events. It's up to you which girl you'll fall in love with!

♥ Full-fledged Photo Capture

In Photo Mode, you can freely adjust the shooting environment, composition, pose, and more! Capture your favorite scenes and save them to your album. Taking photos is one way to deepen your connection with the heroine, and each photo will change the course of your romantic relationship.

♥ Captivating Voice and BGM

Fully voiced by a stellar cast of voice actors! Enjoy engaging interactions with the characters. The BGM by Noriyuki Iwadare, who has worked on numerous romance simulation games, enhances the world of LoveR.

♥ Detailed School Life

Recreate the bittersweet days of school with conversations, schedule management, events, and more!

Rich end-game content! Enjoy eternal summer with PRO Photo Mode!

After your love for your favorite heroine is fulfilled, enjoy taking her portraits.

♥ Wide Variety of Subject Settings

Players can freely specify the heroine's pose and expression during the photo shoot.

From a shy smile to a cool standing pose, you can create a look that matches your theme.

Also, combine a wide variety of outfits and accessories to capture your perfect moment!

♥ Photo Locations and Accessory Arrangements

A variety of photo locations are available, including classrooms, parks, and pools, each with different time zones and seasons.

Add props and furniture to create even more unique scenes.

♥ Filters and Editing Features

Apply filters after taking photos to create your own unique look, from retro to soft to vivid.

You can also fine-tune parameters such as brightness, contrast, and saturation.

content_descriptors.notes:
Sexual Elements: Heroines may appear wearing revealing outfits or swimwear.
Additionally, during gameplay, players may encounter scenes where a girl's underwear is visible or she covers her chest with her hands, regardless of the player's intent.
The game contains depictions of physical contact, such as touching a heroine's body or kissing.
